findings.text: The Jay St-MetroTech to Fulton St shuttle carried 1,560 riders an hour, 93% of plan, using the Brooklyn Bridge bus lane.

trace.label: findings about these stations and routes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding)-[:ABOUT]->(n)
WHERE (n:Station AND n.id IN $stations) OR (n:Route AND n.id IN $routes)
WITH DISTINCT f
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:FROM]->(i:Incident)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ag:Agent)-[:WROTE]->(f)
RETURN f.id AS id, f.text AS text, f.kind AS kind, f.confidence AS confidence, f.validFromMs AS validFromMs,
f.validToMs AS validToMs, f.example AS example, i.id AS incident, ag.name AS agent
ORDER BY validFromMs DESC LIMIT 12

trace.label: past incidents on these routes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident)
WHERE i.status <> 'open' AND any(r IN i.routes WHERE r IN $routes)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Shuttle)-[:FOR]->(i)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:FROM]->(a:Station)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:TO]->(b:Station)
WITH i, collect(CASE WHEN s IS NULL THEN null ELSE {from: a.name, to: b.name, bph: s.busesPerHour, planned: s.planned, observed: s.observed} END) AS shuttles
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.openedMs AS openedMs, i.example AS example, shuttles
ORDER BY openedMs DESC LIMIT 5

trace.label: playbooks for these routes
trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Playbook)-[:FOR]->(r:Route) WHERE r.id IN $routes
RETURN DISTINCT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.steps AS steps, p.uses AS uses, p.lastUsedMs AS lastUsedMs

event.delta: Closing the A/C between High St and Fulton St in this sandbox graph.

result.summary: Opened INC-MVB9OYF8. Closed 4 A/C segments across 2 stations (High St → Fulton St). At 8 a.m. the busiest closed segment carried 11,103 riders an hour.

incident.title: A and C: Cranberry Street Tunnel closed
incident.report: Water condition in the Cranberry Street Tunnel. No A or C trains between High St and Fulton St.

trace.label: reopen closed segments
trace.cypher:
MATCH ()-[r:RUNS {closed: true}]->()
SET r.closed = false, r.minutes = r.baseMinutes,
r.spare = CASE WHEN r.capacity > r.load THEN r.capacity - r.load ELSE 0 END
RETURN count(r) AS n

trace.label: reopen platform rides
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:RIDE {closed: true}]->() SET r.closed = false, r.minutes = r.baseMinutes

trace.label: close out incident
trace.cypher: MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'}) SET i.status = $status, i.closedMs = timestamp()

trace.label: close segments
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a:Station)-[r:RUNS]->(b:Station)
WHERE r.route IN $routes AND a.id IN $stretch AND b.id IN $stretch
SET r.closed = true, r.minutes = $closedMinutes, r.spare = 0
RETURN r.eid AS eid, r.route AS route, a.id AS from, b.id AS to, r.load AS load
ORDER BY eid

trace.label: close the same rides on the platform layer
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:RIDE]->() WHERE r.eid IN $eids SET r.closed = true, r.minutes = $closedMinutes

trace.label: record incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (ag:Agent {id: $agent})
CREATE (ag)-[:OPENED {atMs: timestamp()}]->(i:Incident {id: $id, title: $title, report: $report, routes: $routes,
stretch: $stretch, closedEids: $closedEids, status: 'open', openedMs: timestamp()})
WITH i
MATCH (s:Station) WHERE s.id IN $stretch
CREATE (i)-[:CLOSES]->(s)

event.delta: Measuring the network on a fork: where riders go on their own, and what max flow says is possible.

result.summary: 16,268 displaced riders an hour. If each takes the fastest open path, 0 segments overflow by 0 riders an hour. If riders are spread perfectly (max flow, forward peak direction), the open network can carry 14,267 of 14,267 (100%); 0 cannot move.

trace.label: open incident
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {status: 'open'})
RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.report AS report, i.routes AS routes, i.stretch AS stretch,
i.closedEids AS closedEids, i.status AS status, i.openedMs AS openedMs
ORDER BY i.openedMs DESC LIMIT 1

trace.label: fork the sandbox
trace.cypher: GRAPH.COPY detour:sbx:recordercranberry detour:fork:recordercranberry:inc-mvb9oyf8-3n12wc

trace.label: drop closed segments in the fork
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:RUNS {closed: true}]->() DELETE r

trace.label: drop closed rides in the fork
trace.cypher: MATCH ()-[r:RIDE {closed: true}]->() DELETE r

trace.label: displaced riders
trace.cypher:
MATCH (o:Station)-[d:DEMAND]->(x:Station)
WHERE any(e IN d.via WHERE e IN $closed)
RETURN o.id AS o, x.id AS d, d.riders AS riders, d.via AS via

trace.label: free displaced riders' capacity
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $freed AS f
MATCH ()-[r:RUNS {eid: f.eid}]->()
SET r.freed = f.riders,
r.spare = CASE WHEN r.capacity - r.load + f.riders > 0 THEN r.capacity - r.load + f.riders ELSE 0 END

trace.label: forward source and sink
trace.cypher:
CREATE (src:Hub {id: $src}), (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
WITH src, snk
UNWIND $sources AS s
MATCH (x:Station {id: s.id})
CREATE (src)-[:FLOW {spare: s.cap, kind: $kind, ref: -1}]->(x)

trace.label: forward sinks
trace.cypher:
MATCH (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
UNWIND $sinks AS s
MATCH (x:Station {id: s.id})
CREATE (x)-[:FLOW {spare: s.cap, kind: $kind, ref: -1}]->(snk)

trace.label: backward source and sink
trace.cypher:
CREATE (src:Hub {id: $src}), (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
WITH src, snk
UNWIND $sources AS s
MATCH (x:Station {id: s.id})
CREATE (src)-[:FLOW {spare: s.cap, kind: $kind, ref: -1}]->(x)

trace.label: backward sinks
trace.cypher:
MATCH (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
UNWIND $sinks AS s
MATCH (x:Station {id: s.id})
CREATE (x)-[:FLOW {spare: s.cap, kind: $kind, ref: -1}]->(snk)

trace.label: clear corridor flow edges
trace.cypher: MATCH (:Station)-[f:FLOW]->(:Station) DELETE f

trace.label: aggregate spare capacity by corridor
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a:Station)-[r]->(b:Station)
WHERE type(r) IN $kinds
WITH a, b, sum(r.spare) AS spare,
collect(CASE type(r) WHEN 'RUNS' THEN 'R' + toString(r.eid) WHEN 'WALK' THEN 'W' + toString(r.wid) ELSE 'B' + toString(r.bid) END) AS refs
CREATE (a)-[:FLOW {spare: spare, kind: 'NET', refs: refs}]->(b)

trace.label: forward max flow
trace.cypher:
MATCH (src:Hub {id: $src}), (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
CALL algo.maxFlow({sourceNodes: [src], targetNodes: [snk], relationshipTypes: ['FLOW'], capacityProperty: 'spare'})
YIELD maxFlow, edges, edgeFlows
RETURN maxFlow, [e IN edges | [e.kind, startNode(e).id, endNode(e).id]] AS es, edgeFlows AS flows

trace.label: forward residual graph
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a)-[r:FLOW]->(b) WHERE r.kind IN $kinds
RETURN r.kind AS kind, a.id AS a, b.id AS b, r.spare AS cap, r.refs AS refs

trace.label: backward max flow
trace.cypher:
MATCH (src:Hub {id: $src}), (snk:Hub {id: $snk})
CALL algo.maxFlow({sourceNodes: [src], targetNodes: [snk], relationshipTypes: ['FLOW'], capacityProperty: 'spare'})
YIELD maxFlow, edges, edgeFlows
RETURN maxFlow, [e IN edges | [e.kind, startNode(e).id, endNode(e).id]] AS es, edgeFlows AS flows

trace.label: backward residual graph
trace.cypher:
MATCH (a)-[r:FLOW]->(b) WHERE r.kind IN $kinds
RETURN r.kind AS kind, a.id AS a, b.id AS b, r.spare AS cap, r.refs AS refs

trace.label: reroute displaced riders on fastest open paths
trace.cypher:
UNWIND $pairs AS p
MATCH (a:Station {id: p.o}), (b:Station {id: p.d})
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: a, targetNode: b, relTypes: $types, weightProp: 'minutes'})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN p.o AS o, p.d AS d, pathWeight AS minutes,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'RIDE' | r.eid] AS eids,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'BUS' | r.bid] AS bids,
[r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'WALK' | r.wid] AS walks

trace.label: drop the fork
trace.cypher: GRAPH.DELETE detour:fork:recordercranberry:inc-mvb9oyf8-3n12wc

trace.label: remember the capacity picture
trace.cypher:
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $id})
SET i.displaced = $displaced, i.overflow = $overflow, i.stranded = $stranded,
i.required = $required, i.absorbed = $absorbed, i.unmet = $unmet, i.measuredMs = timestamp()

event.delta: Everyone displaced still has an open path and max flow has no shortfall, so no buses: the plan is to steer riders.

result.summary: PLAN-MVB9OZ0D: no extra buses. Every displaced rider has an open path and nothing overflows on the fastest paths. Once published, the rider desk routes each remembered rider.

**What broke** No A/C service between High St and Fulton St.

**What the network can take** On their fastest paths nothing new overflows. Max flow moves 14,267 of 14,267 in the peak direction.
**Recommended plan** PLAN-MVB9OZ0D: no extra buses; the rider desk steers each remembered rider onto open lines.
**From memory** Since Sep 3, 2026: The Jay St-MetroTech to Fulton St shuttle carried 1,560 riders an hour, 93% of plan, using the Brooklyn Bridge bus lane.
